evidence: Two-year GCM tests at 15 levels, one realization each from the design climate's year-19 restart carried onto the levels by the conservative remap: the baseline with the longwave correction refitted provisionally on the 15-level month trial's cloud-free columns, and the same with the 14-level test's correction carried from ten levels. They are set against the 14-level test and the 10-level run with the depth test (deep200, without the shallow cap) over the same years from the same restart: the first two years of a spin-up, so they show the direction and early size of the changes and not a settled climate. The CM1 numbers are the settled boxes (the sea box's third lunar day, the land box's second), forced by Kuo's GCM. The surface layer's numbers are area means of the model's own fluxes, with the lowest level's height, the neutral transfer coefficient and the free-convection factor estimated from 3-day means. The bit checks compare the GCM's own output and restarts.
reading_rule: stages[stage][run]: rain by quarter (sunrise-noon, noon-sunset, sunset-midnight, midnight-sunrise; mm/day, all rain and the convective part) at the Near-side Sea's cells and the land box's cells; upper_air.at_heights_k the lunar-day mean at the sea cells taken onto the box's levels at equal shares of the surface pressure, at 18.9, 29.8, 41.8 and 55.8 km as box_upper_air does; <site>_lowest_level the sites' lowest level and the one above it (temperature, vapour as a mixing ratio), the mass-weighted mean over sigma 0.9883-1 (the 15-level bottom layer, 0-0.6 km) from the conservative remap's reconstruction on each run's own grid, the air at 2 m (PlaSim's: the lowest level's temperature taken dry-adiabatically to the ground's pressure) and the ground; global the yearly summaries' means with the area-mean rain, its convective share, the top two levels (sigma 0.038, 0.119; water in ppmv by volume) and the cloud cover of the three lowest layers; sea_t_minus_l14_on_14_levels_k the sea site's lunar-day mean temperature on the 14-level run's levels less that run's; the convective heating (W/m2 by layer, top first) and cloud cover by quarter at the sea site. bit_checks: every output variable and the restart of the 10- and 14-level month trials rerun after the 15-level build against the earlier ones. surface_layer: surface_layer_check.py's account (its docstring) of each run's fluxes, lowest-level height, neutral transfer coefficient, wind under 1 m/s, the two lowest layers' heating by process and the free-convection factor over unstable sea.
